hook_card.text:
الخطوط ديال الكرش ما مشاوش؟
السبب واحد: الجلد تقطع من لتحت
hook_card.red: السبب واحد: الجلد تقطع من لتحت

shots.vo_line: حبسي… أنا هو الخط اللي فكرشك. أنا وخويا الحمر. من نهار ولدتي وحنا ساكنين
shots.row: Close-up of the belly from the reference photo: one white stretch mark has come alive with sly eyes, a grin and a tiny crown; a red stretch mark on the side is his little brother
shots.h3_prompt: The crowned white stretch mark opens his wink into a sly grin and talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures, tapping his chest proudly. He jerks a thumb at his little red brother, who keeps waving and bobbing with a cheeky grin. Both sway smugly on the skin, breathing and blinking, until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Minor: small cartoon motion-line marks are drawn beside the red brother's waving hand.
shots.qa: window: Villain talks and gestures well and the red brother waves the whole clip, but from 4.65 s the villain holds a closed-mouth smirk with hands on hips while the line still runs; cut before it (stretch x1.13).

shots.vo_line: هنا. ولّيتي كتلبسي التريكو الطويل، وكتطفي الضو قبل ما يدخل راجلك… وأنا كنضحك.
shots.row: The belly character pulling a long T-shirt down over herself and switching off the bathroom light; the villain laughing
shots.h3_prompt: The belly tugs the long T-shirt down over her stretch marks with a worried pout, then presses the light switch; the ceiling light goes off and the room dims to the warm lantern glow. She hugs the T-shirt to herself, shoulders sagging, and keeps shuffling her feet on the rug, blinking sadly, until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Frame does not fully match its row: the speaking villain (laughing) is not in the frame, so his laugh is voice-only and the belly must not lip-move.

shots.vo_line: وماشي حيت ما دهنتيش. فالحمل الكرش كبرات بالزربة، والجلد ما قدرش يكبر معاها، فتقطع من لتحت… وتما دخلت أنا. ونتي كتدهني من
shots.row: The villain pointing up at snapped pink elastic threads above him
shots.h3_prompt: The crowned white stretch mark jabs his finger up at the snapped pink threads and talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures. The torn thread ends sway and twitch above him. He spreads his arms wide, then thumps his chest proudly, while his red brother nods and chuckles; both keep bobbing and breathing until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.

shots.vo_line: الفوق: الشبة كتنشفك وكتحرقك. زيت جونسون كيبقى فوق الجلد بحال البلاستيك. زيت الزيتون واللوز تقال، كيلزقو فالحوايج. الكريمة
shots.row: An alum stone, a baby-oil puddle, olive and almond oil drops and cream blobs stuck on the "ceiling" of the cave; a laser device with a price on its screen; the villain lounging on a sofa of torn threads
shots.h3_prompt: The lounging crowned stretch mark talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures, lazily pointing up at the alum stone, then at the dripping oil puddle. The olive and almond oil drops wobble and stretch but stay stuck to the ceiling. He waves a dismissive hand while his red brother laughs and bounces on the sofa until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Minor: the row's price on the laser screen is not in the frame (fine, it would be text).
shots.qa: window: Talks, points up and waves until about 6.9 s; then leans back eyes closed with a closed-mouth smile for the last 1.6 s (only the brother keeps laughing). The ceiling props stay as in the frame (stretch x1.12).

shots.vo_line: ب250 درهم كترطب الفوق وكتسالي فشهر. والليزر؟ 1500 درهم للمرة. كلهم فوق… وأنا لتحت مرتاح.
shots.row: An alum stone, a baby-oil puddle, olive and almond oil drops and cream blobs stuck on the "ceiling" of the cave; a laser device with a price on its screen; the villain lounging on a sofa of torn threads
shots.h3_prompt: The lounging crowned stretch mark points at the cream blobs, then at the laser device as its red light blinks, and talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures. He folds his hands behind his head and sinks deeper into the sofa with a smug sigh. His red brother copies him, and both keep wiggling contentedly until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.qa: window: Points and talks until 4.4 s, then sinks back with his hands behind his head; from 5.1 s both lie still on the sofa (idle_from 5.6) and only the villain's mouth moves. Keep 1.3 s of the lounging, which fits 'and I relax down here', and cut before the long still tail (stretch x1.14).

shots.vo_line: …لا لا لا، شنو هادشي؟ غوتيفا؟ سيروم خفيف، الجلد كيشربو كامل، وكيدخل حتى لعندي! زيت أركان كيغذي الجلد، فيتامين E كيعاونو يبرا، والألوفيرا
shots.row: Two golden spotlights; a Guttiva drop arriving from above; the villain's eyes wide in panic
shots.h3_prompt: The golden drop falls between the spotlights. The crowned stretch mark talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures, flinching back in panic and waving his hands. His red brother ducks behind him; both keep trembling as the golden light glows brighter until the end. The bottle keeps its exact shape and label, standing still. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.frame_issue: Minor: the bottle is hazy and half-fused into the skin ceiling; the label small print is garbled (e.g. 'BLANCHES ET BOUGSE ESTOMPEES'). Brand name, SERUM, ANTI-VERGETURES and 60 ml read correctly.

shots.vo_line: كتبرد الحمورية. ما كيحرقش بحال الشبة، ما كيلزقش بحال الزيت، ما كيبقاش فوق بحال الكريمة، وما
shots.row: Golden serum drops raining down, the threads glowing and re-joining, argan leaf, vitamin E and aloe icons, the red brother fading
shots.h3_prompt: Golden drops drip from the glowing torn edge and the light swirls brighten. The crowned stretch mark talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures, his smug grin slipping as he glances up at the drops. The leaves and the capsule keep drifting in slow circles while he crosses his arms and sulks, tapping his fingers, until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.qa: fallback window: Talking shot, but the mouth never speaks: closed smirk 0-2.1 s, a frozen open grin 2.4-3.3 s, then he sulks with arms crossed and no visible mouth 3.6-5.9 s. The drops, leaves and capsule keep moving; there are no other defects.

shots.vo_line: كيكلفكش بحال الليزر. دقيقتين الصباح والعشية… فـ30 يوم خويا الحمر بدا كيخفّ، فـ60 أنا كنقرب
shots.row: Golden serum drops raining down, the threads glowing and re-joining, argan leaf, vitamin E and aloe icons, the red brother fading
shots.h3_prompt: The faded red brother waves goodbye and fades further into the skin. The crowned stretch mark turns to him in shock and talks with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures, wringing his hands nervously. The glowing pink threads around him keep knitting together while he grows paler and slumps lower until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
shots.qa: window: Talks with wringing hands from 1.35 to 5.3 s (smirking and glancing before that); from 5.4 s his mouth stays shut while he slumps and pales. Cut there so the mouth moves under the line (stretch x1.11). The faint red brother is simply gone (fade intended).

shots.vo_line: للون ديال الجلد، وفـ90… لا لا، رجعي! وبلا ما تطلبي غوتيفا… خليني مرتاح هنا.
shots.row: The villain shrinking and hiding in a small dark hole, whispering
shots.h3_prompt: The tiny crowned stretch mark glances around nervously, then lowers his finger from his lips and whispers with clear, natural mouth movement and expressive gestures, beckoning with a little hand. He sinks deeper into the hole, still whispering and shooing the viewer away, while the edges of the hole slowly close in around him until the end. Static camera. No speech bubbles, no text, no new objects. One continuous shot from this first frame: the same characters, design, colours, setting and lighting for the whole clip; no new characters, no humans, no hands, no speech bubbles, no text or letters anywhere, no scene cut.
